title: Chasho
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: There were two: one in Shmuel's time, as in [Pesachim 40a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.40a.6), where Shmuel issued a practical ruling in the village of the household of bar Chasho; and Yimar bar Chasho, in Rava's time, as in [Ketubot 84b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.84b.12).[^1]

notes.text: Ketubot names the creditor Yeimar bar Chasho. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2055&lang=en) discusses these passages under Chashui and places the second in Rabbah’s time, where Hyman gives Rava.
